output.text: The model railway club met on Saturday morning to prepare the layout for the upcoming exhibition. Assume that Eli is the team captain. Fay is younger than Kai, though both have been members for several years and know the wiring diagrams well. Kira took the photographs. The layout itself stretches across three long tables joined at the corners, with a river running through a papier-mache valley. Cleo ranked highest in last years scenery competition, while Kai came in just behind her in the same event.
